messages.author: 695daabdfd4a0e5c
messages.subject: scale_x_log() & formatter="percentage"
parts:
scale_y_log() and scale_y_continuous(formatter = "percent") no longer work

see http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_continuous.html

i.e.
m <- qplot(rating, votes, data=subset(movies, votes > 1000), na.rm = T)
m + scale_y_log()

x <- rnorm(10) * 100000
y <- seq(0, 1, length = 10)
p <- qplot(x, y)
p + scale_y_continuous(formatter = "percent")

I have found the new syntax for log i.e.

 m+scale_y_continuous(trans="log")

But not percentage.

Any ideas, plus when will the help be updated?


I am using version ggplot2 Version: 0.9.1

Laurie
